_doc:
Pre-registration record for the study protocol. The `pre_reg_lock_*` fields identify the build and schema version that this document describes; `tests/pre-reg.test.js` pins the live `src/config.js` to the `config_locked` block below so that the deployed build cannot drift from the document, and checks the thresholds in `collection_time_screen_outs` against the constants in the source. After the document is filed with a registry, any change to `config_locked` or `collection_time_screen_outs` constitutes an amendment.

The runtime config must canonicalise byte-identically to `config_locked` below; `tests/pre-reg.test.js` enforces this. Values in square brackets are placeholders that are filled in before launch (`scripts/preflight.js --strict-deployment` fails while any remain in participant-facing text).

study.title: Interactions Between Visual Imagery Use and Visuo-Spatial Working Memory: Cross-modal Follow-up

design_summary.d_only_display_rotation: d_only trials show the grid rotated by display_rotation_deg (integer, -90..90, 0 not used), drawn from the same six 30-degree strata as the imagery angles and ordered under the same same-sign run limit and minimum angle step.

hypotheses.label: Dual-task cost (visual modality)
hypotheses.equivalence_test: TOST with d_bound = 0.1 if the directional test fails.

hypotheses.label: Modality specificity (Modality × Load interaction)
hypotheses.claim: The 2 (modality: dots, tones) × 2 (load: single, dual) within-subjects interaction discriminates a modality-general account (similar ΔAccuracy) from a visuo-spatial-specific account (greater I+D cost).
hypotheses.test: Bayesian model comparison with default JZS prior r = sqrt(2)/2 (≈ 0.707). Decision rule: BF10 > 3 supports interaction; BF01 > 3 supports null (modality-general).

hypotheses.label: Symmetric imagery cost
hypotheses.claim: Star accuracy in I+D < I_only AND I+T < I_only.
hypotheses.test: Two one-tailed paired t-tests; both must reach α = 0.05.

hypotheses.label: On-letter facilitation replicates and is amplified under dual-task
hypotheses.claim: Within memory-bearing conditions, accuracy(T_on) > accuracy(T_off); the on/off effect is larger when imagery is concurrent (I+D, I+T) than in single-task (D_only, T_only).
hypotheses.test: Repeated-measures ANOVA on probe_type × concurrency, with planned contrast on the interaction.

exploratory_analyses: Star × probe-type contingency: does dual-task release happen more cleanly when star is off the cell of the upcoming probe?

Strategy × dual-task cost: pre-registered Spearman rho on the Structural Chunking composite (strategy_q01 + strategy_q02 + strategy_q03, range 3–15) against per-participant ΔAccuracy (single − dual), separately for I+D and I+T.

Imagery-maintenance composite × accuracy: Spearman rho on imagery_maintenance_id (strategy_q13 + strategy_q15, range 2–10) against I+D star accuracy, and imagery_maintenance_it (strategy_q16 + strategy_q18, range 2–10) against I+T star accuracy — construct-validity check that endorsement of continuous-visualization / phase-specific-focus tracks the imagery-maintenance manipulation.
Strategy-questionnaire item-level Spearman screening across the 19 items (5-point Likert) against overall accuracy and ΔAccuracy.

sampling_plan.stopping_rule: If retained N < 40 after exclusions, recruit additional batches of 10 until retained N >= 40.

prolific_prescreeners: Vision: normal or corrected-to-normal vision (glasses or contacts)
Device: a desktop or laptop computer, used with headphones
filters.note: Eligibility is determined only by the Prolific prescreeners above; the study does not test age, hearing or vision.

rules.rule: A trial whose row has a non-empty `guard_flags` is dropped from analysis. `guard_flags` lists the display-guard events since the previous trial (zoom change, fullscreen exit, resize, tab hidden or visible, window blur or focus, --mm reset, pause, resume).
Participants whose screen calibration outcome is `inconsistent_accepted` (the two card settings of the last attempt differ by more than the consistency tolerance but were accepted) are excluded.
Fails > 1 of the 3 typed-instruction attention checks (strict greater-than; equality at threshold is not exclusion).
Overall recognition accuracy <= 0.55 in EITHER D_only OR T_only single-task condition.
Per-trial RT < 250 ms is treated as anticipatory and excluded from RT analyses (logged but not enforced at collection).

exclusion_rules._doc: Rules applied at analysis. Checks that end a session at collection are listed separately under `collection_time_screen_outs`.

collection_time_screen_outs._doc: Checks that end a session during data collection. They are task-capability checks, not eligibility screening, and are disclosed in the consent form. A participant who fails one is shown an explanation and sent to Prolific with the screen-out completion code; the rows collected so far are uploaded first. Thresholds are the constants in the source files named in each entry.

rules.rule: A phone or tablet is detected from the user agent (iPhone, iPod, iPad, iPadOS reporting a Macintosh user agent with more than one touch point, Android, other mobile user agents), or the device has neither hover nor a fine pointer.

rules.when: after consent, demographics, viewing-distance and display-mode screens
rules.rule: Two card-width settings per attempt (one starting low, one high, random order), up to 3 attempts. An attempt is usable if both settings moved the slider, px per mm lies in the bounds and the implied screen width lies in the bounds. A usable attempt is accepted if the two settings agree within the tolerance; a usable but inconsistent attempt is accepted only on the last attempt and flagged. If no attempt is accepted the session ends.

rules.when: after the volume instruction and fullscreen
rules.rule: The tone sweep plays up to 10 times; if the participant never reports the tones as clearly and comfortably audible, the session ends.
6 trials (three 200 Hz tones, say which is quietest); passing is 5 or more correct. Recorded as `headphones_pass`; never ends the session.

8 trials with two adjacent tones of the bank at the participant's playback level; 7 or more correct is required. One retry after a prompt to raise the volume; a second failure ends the session. A further block of 8 trials 12 dB lower is recorded only.

rules.when: after the pitch check, in fullscreen
rules.rule: Frame timing and timer accuracy are sampled; the check fails if any threshold below is violated. One retry after a prompt to close other programs; a second failure ends the session.
Cumulative practice accuracy must reach the criterion; one repeat of the whole practice is allowed (2 attempts). Failing the second attempt ends the session.
If the zoom or fullscreen change cannot be restored, the pause overlay offers an end-the-session button after 30 s; using it ends the session. The guard is switched off after the last trial.

counterbalance_invariants.claim: On/off-pattern membership computed from gray_pattern = [1,2,3,7,10,11,12,13,14,17,21,22,23] minus centre cell 12; 12 on-pattern + 12 off-pattern non-centre cells.

Every single-task (D_only, T_only, I_only) trial places open-square dummies at the slot positions the matched dual-task condition uses for its other modality, and each dummy slot runs on the envelope of the event it stands in for: D_only and T_only dummies stand in for the matched I+D / I+T star and run on the S-slot envelope (3000 ms + 500 ms), while I_only dummies stand in for the matched I+D / I+T memory item and run on the M-slot envelope (1000 ms + 500 ms). Total slot count per trial and total encoding-window duration are therefore identical between each single-task condition and the dual-task condition it stands in for.

Run-length cap = 2 for memory-vs-star sequencing within a dual-task trial. For each 24-trial condition block, 24 sequences are drawn (with replacement) from the 14 valid length-6 binary strings (3 zeros + 3 ones, no run > 2), with the added constraint that each of the 6 slot positions hosts M on exactly 12 trials and S on exactly 12 trials. There are 14 valid length-6 strings, so the 24 sequences of a block are drawn with replacement; the slot-position 12/12 balance is enforced by construction in `src/scheduler/within-trial.js`.

Across 24 trials of a given memory-bearing condition, each of {T_on, T_off, F_on, F_off} appears exactly 18 times (72 probes / 4 = 18), with each probe serial position receiving six instances of each type. In the dual-task conditions, each encoding-position-to-probe-position mapping (3 encoding positions × 3 probe positions = 9 cells) appears exactly 8 times.
Across the 24 trials of any condition, each of the 6 within-trial slot positions hosts a memory-item position on exactly 12 trials and a star-or-placeholder position on exactly 12 trials.

Across each 24-trial memory-bearing condition, 36 encoded memory items are on-pattern and 36 are off-pattern, and each of the three encoding positions receives exactly 12 on-pattern and 12 off-pattern items.
Across each 24-trial imagery-bearing condition, 36 stars are on-pattern and 36 are off-pattern, and each of the three star serial positions receives exactly 12 on-pattern and 12 off-pattern stars.
Run-length cap = 2 for trial-type interleaving across the block.

In each 24-trial condition with a rotation (I_only, I_D, I_T imagery angles and D_only display angles) the angle is drawn from six 30-degree strata (-90..-61, -60..-31, -30..-1, 1..30, 31..60, 61..90), 4 per stratum, no angle repeated within a condition, 0 not used. In a main block the trials of one condition are reordered among themselves so that, over all rotated trials, no more than 6 consecutive rotations have the same sign and consecutive angles differ by at least 3 degrees. D_only display angles are drawn after all other draws of the D_only block, so the other counterbalance draws do not depend on them.

Every counterbalance step consumes from a single Mulberry32 PRNG seeded from a hash of PROLIFIC_PID. Two participants with different PIDs get different schedules; the same PID always produces the same schedule.
counterbalance_invariants.tested_in: tests/main-blocks.test.js (reproducibility from same seed; divergence under different seeds)

data_record.claim: Every per-trial data row written by the runner validates against schemas/trial.schema.json (the per-row JSON Schema). Phase tags listed in the schema's `phase` enum are exhaustive — adding a phase requires editing both the runner emitter and the schema.
data_record.csv_export_compatibility: Analysis scripts read column conventions from `Ast_*`, `Dot_*`, `Qmark_*` and `Mid_Q_*` prefixes. The CSV export transforms the per-row JSON to those columns; it is not pre-registered (it is a downstream transform of the locked raw record).

strategy.instrument: Strategy questionnaire — 19 items adapted from a longer instrument; items written in the pattern/star/circle/tone vocabulary of this study and selected under retention rules (a) |ρ| ≥ .30 with accuracy or dual-task cost at p ≤ .075, (b) component of the GLM-validated Structural Chunking composite, (c) theoretical centrality to imagery maintenance; 5 items for the tone-only and image+tone conditions (Pitch Labeling, Auditory Imagery, Contour Encoding, Tonal Chunking, Concurrent Auditory Rehearsal) anchored in Dowling (1978), Hubbard (2010), Williamson et al. (2010), and Logie (1995); 1 rotation item (Probe Rotation Alternative; Cooper 1975 / Carpenter & Just 1985).
strategy.scale: 5-point agreement Likert; 1 = Strongly disagree, 5 = Strongly agree

composites.structural_chunking_composite: sum(strategy_q01, strategy_q02, strategy_q03); range 3-15; GLM-validated predictor (β = 0.415, z = 7.68, p < .001)
composites.imagery_maintenance_id: sum(strategy_q13, strategy_q15); range 2-10; Continuous Visualization + Phase-Specific Focus, I+D condition
composites.imagery_maintenance_it: sum(strategy_q16, strategy_q18); range 2-10; same constructs applied to the new I+T condition for cross-modal generalisation

attention_checks.format: typed single-word response, normalised by trim+lowercase (no punctuation strip)
attention_checks.comparator: strict greater-than (failed > max_failures triggers exclusion; equality does not)
attention_checks.session_termination: no — failed participant completes the session and receives full pay; the flag is recorded for analysis-level exclusion only

open_questions_at_lock_time._doc: These items are deliberately NOT pinned in the `config_locked` snapshot because they require researcher-side decisions before filing. Each is tracked as a deployment-readiness item, not a methodological undecidable. Once the document is filed, the `post_registration_amendment_required_if` field on each item describes the conditions under which a later change would constitute an amendment.

items.status: Placeholder DataPipe experiment id in config.js; replace before launch.
items.fallback: Uploader returns 'no_endpoint'; debrief node triggers JSON download for participant to email.
items.post_registration_amendment_required_if: Hosting choice changes data-retention policy or introduces an additional identifier in the URL.

items.status: Placeholder in config.js (pinned in config_locked); replace with the study's completion codes before launch.
items.post_registration_amendment_required_if: Completion-code substitution changes payment logic (it does not — Prolific cc is study-level).
n/a (OSF link is a pointer, not a methodological commitment).

items.status: 19-item English questionnaire (`src/questionnaire/strategy.js`) with 5 sections; used in exploratory analyses only (see `exploratory_analyses` entries 2 and 3).
items.post_registration_amendment_required_if: Strategy-questionnaire data are used in confirmatory (not exploratory) analyses.
